selection.bestFor: high-end cosmetic / med-spa dentistry; premium authority; strong dark imagery

type.substitutionCriteria: credible at weight 300 in display sizes; tight tracking without collapsing counters; cool, precise personality

heading.emphasisDevice: scale + light weight against negative space; no kickers, no mixed weights

composition.hero: centered headline + sub over a scrimmed dark image; single champagne gradient sweep behind the headline; one ghost-outline CTA
composition.services: numbered list, gold index numerals, hairline dividers, no card chrome
composition.reviews: one large single-featured quote, light-weight serif-free, centered on black

imagery.crop: full-bleed and wide cinematic crops; sharp sm-radius containers when contained
imagery.grading: high-contrast, deep shadows, desaturated cool tones with warm skin preserved; scrim-friendly
imagery.framing: subjects emerge from darkness; negative space dominates; single light source feel
imagery.subjectTreatment: editorial and composed, not candid; confident direct expressions; macro detail shots as texture

voice.rhythm: spare, declarative, unhurried; short headlines with no qualifier words; whitespace does the persuading

gaps.detail: existing variants are untested on a near-black background / inverted text roles; light-theme assumptions may be hardcoded in component CSS
champagne gradient sweep — brand-tokens.js emits flat hexes only; no gradient token exists to render the accent sweep

fidelityChecks: background stays near-black / dark theme is preserved (not auto-lightened)
champagne accent appears as a single restrained sweep, not a full neon wash
hero remains centered over a scrimmed image (do not penalize as cliche)
card borders read as hairline-glow on black (not flat gray boxes)
headings carry no uppercase eyebrow/kicker — emphasis comes from scale and light weight only
